promql_note: No PromQL HTTP requests in this HAR; Codex AI Center widgets use Dataprime via gRPC InternalDataprimeQueryService/Query.
dataprime_unique:
source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'codex.sse_event'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.kind'] == 'response.completed'
| create model from $d.logRecord.attributes.model
| create input from $d.logRecord.attributes.input_token_count:number
| create output from $d.logRecord.attributes.output_token_count:number
| create cached from $d.logRecord.attributes.cached_token_count:number
| groupby model aggregate sum(input) as totalInput, sum(output) as totalOutput, sum(cached) as totalCached, count() as requestCount
| create totalTokens from totalInput + totalOutput
| sort by totalTokens desc
| choose model, totalTokens, totalInput, totalOutput, totalCached, requestCount

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'codex.sse_event'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.kind'] == 'response.completed'
| create input from $d.logRecord.attributes.input_token_count:number
| create output from $d.logRecord.attributes.output_token_count:number
| create cached from $d.logRecord.attributes.cached_token_count:number
| aggregate sum(input) as totalInput, sum(output) as totalOutput, sum(cached) as totalCached
| create totalTokens from totalInput + totalOutput
| choose totalTokens, totalInput, totalOutput, totalCached

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'codex.sse_event'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.kind'] == 'response.completed'
| create input from $d.logRecord.attributes.input_token_count:number
| create output from $d.logRecord.attributes.output_token_count:number
| groupby roundTime($m.timestamp, 300000ms) as Time aggregate sum(input) as totalInput, sum(output) as totalOutput
| create tokens from totalInput + totalOutput
| sort by Time asc
| choose Time, tokens, totalInput, totalOutput

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'codex.sse_event'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.kind'] == 'response.completed'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['user.email'] != null
| create user from $d.logRecord.attributes['user.email']
| create tokens from $d.logRecord.attributes.input_token_count:number + $d.logRecord.attributes.output_token_count:number
| groupby user aggregate sum(tokens) as totalTokens
| sort by totalTokens desc
| limit 1
| choose user as userEmail, totalTokens

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['conversation.id'] != null
| create conversation_id from $d.logRecord.attributes['conversation.id']
| groupby conversation_id aggregate max($m.timestamp) as session_end, min($m.timestamp) as session_start
| create session_duration from (session_end - session_start) / 1ms
| aggregate sum(session_duration) as total_ms
| choose total_ms

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'codex.sse_event'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.kind'] == 'response.completed'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['conversation.id'] != null
| aggregate distinct_count($d.logRecord.attributes['conversation.id']) as uniqueSessions
| choose uniqueSessions

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $l.applicationname != null || $l.subsystemname != null
| groupby $l.applicationname as applicationName, $l.subsystemname as subsystemName aggregate count() as count
| sort by count desc
| choose applicationName, subsystemName

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'codex.sse_event'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes.model != null
| groupby $d.logRecord.attributes.model as model aggregate count() as count
| sort by count desc
| choose model

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $d.logRecord.attributes['user.email'] != null
| aggregate distinct_count($d.logRecord.attributes['user.email']) as uniqueUsers
| choose uniqueUsers

source logs
| filter $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'
| limit 1
| aggregate count() as count
| choose count

source spans
| filter $l.serviceName == 'codex_cli_rs'
| filter $l.operationName == 'run_turn'
| create dur_ms from $m.duration:number / 1000
| aggregate avg(dur_ms) as avg_ms

source spans
| filter tags['gen_ai.system'] != null
| count into total_spans
notes: Widgets filter resource with $d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs' and log fields under $d.logRecord.attributes[...].
If Explore shows logs but dashboards are empty, verify resource uses `service_name` for this sim (not semantic `service.name`) and that log-record keypaths match Explorer for your tenant.
